ARRL（美国业余无线电联盟）成立。: The ARRL (American Radio Relay League) is founded.
IARU（国际业余无线电联盟）成立。: The IARU (International Amateur Radio Union) is founded.
数字模式兴起，PSK31、JT65、FT8 相继普及，弱信号通信进入新时代。: Digital modes take off: PSK31, JT65 and FT8 spread one after another, and weak-signal communication enters a new era.
苏联发射首颗人造卫星，催生卫星业余通信。: The Soviet Union launches the first artificial satellite, giving rise to amateur satellite communication.
赫兹用实验证实电磁波存在。: Hertz proves experimentally that electromagnetic waves exist.
首颗业余卫星 OSCAR-1 发射。: The first amateur satellite, OSCAR-1, is launched.
